errors.evidence: Description states Precision begins at approximately 81.1%, but the figure shows it starting at around 84.1%.
Description states Recall begins at approximately 83.5%, but the figure shows it starting at around 86.5%.
Description states F1 Score starts at approximately 82.3%, but the figure shows it starting at around 84.1%.
Description incorrectly claims that all metrics exhibit a strict monotonic increasing trend, while F1 Score decreases slightly between mBERT-30 and mBERT-50.
The description fails to mention the units (percentage) clearly for the y-axis beyond the initial mention.
No clear summary or main insight stated at the end of the description.
